# `chips`

Helper: `chips(items, { vert })`  
Kit (`src/ui`): `FilterChip` (shared, `ops-ui.tsx`) · status: shared (next to the kit)  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaChipWrap` (core:ui), `PemaFilterChip` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Row of filter pills; each pill: label, optional count bubble.

## Variants

- Horizontal (default)
- `vert`: stacked, label left and count right
- Item `sel` (selected), `dis` (disabled), plain

## States

- Default: surface, line, ink-soft
- Selected: brand-500 fill, white text, count on brand-100
- Disabled: 50% opacity

## Tokens

surface, line, ink-soft, tile, brand-500, brand-100, brand-700, radius-pill

## Do

- Use `Tất cả` as the first chip of a filter
- Show the count when the list is long

## Don't

- Do not use chips for navigation (tabs) or for a status (badge)

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Height 36.

## Mobile (390)

Height 40 on the canvas (44 in the kit); the row wraps.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Filter pills: `'Tất cả'` or `[label, 'sel'|'dis'|'', count]`. `vert` stacks them (group lists with counts)
